items.question: How fast do you respond?
items.answer: Within one business hour, from a real engineer, not a bot or a ticket queue. Send a voice note or form after hours, and you'll hear back the next business morning.

items.question: What do I need to provide to get started?
items.answer: Just your own words. A voice note, a one-minute form, or an email. No documents, no specs, no prep. We ask whatever we need during the Tech Review.

items.question: What if I don't know anything about technology?
items.answer: Perfect. That's our job. You're not here to learn how to use a drill; you're here to hang the picture. We bring the pre-drilled wall with the anchors already in. Tell us what your business needs; we make it happen in plain words.

items.question: Who actually does the work?
items.answer: The two owners. No account managers, no handoffs: the person who takes your call is the person who builds and fixes. You always know who's looking after your house.

items.question: What happens after the first contact?
items.answer: We review what you shared, invite you to a 15-minute Tech Review, and hand you a one-page Tech Plan with your options and prices in under 2 days. No commitment. You decide the next step.

items.question: Do you work with businesses outside Mexico?
items.answer: Yes. We work with businesses in Mexico, the United States, and Canada. Almost everything is done remotely over video calls.

items.question: Can I cancel at any time?
items.answer: Yes. No trapping contracts. Each phase has a clear scope and a clear price, and you decide whether to continue with the next one.

items.question: Is there support after project delivery?
items.answer: Yes. We stay on as long as you want us, with support and maintenance that fit how you work. We don't hand you the keys and disappear.

services.carlosRabagoQuote: The best fix is often the simple one. Listening, understanding, and building something that holds up beats clever every time.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy - CROW SYSTEMS
privacy.description: Read the Privacy Policy for Crow Systems to understand how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Crow Systems collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our website and services.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.content: Crow Systems respects user privacy and is committed to protecting personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how information is collected, used, and protected when you visit our website or engage our consulting services.

sections.title: 2. Information We Collect
sections.intro: We may collect the following information:
items: Name and company information
Email address and phone number
Consultation and project details
Audio submissions (if provided)
Technical browser and device information
Website usage analytics

sections.title: 3. How Information Is Used
sections.intro: Collected information may be used to:
items: Respond to inquiries and consultation requests
Provide and improve our consulting services
Improve website functionality and user experience
Process submissions and manage projects
Send requested communications and updates
Maintain security and reliability of our systems
sections.extra: Crow Systems does not sell personal information to third parties.

sections.title: 4. Audio Submission Handling
sections.content: Audio recordings submitted through the website may be temporarily stored and processed for consultation review purposes. Users should avoid submitting highly sensitive, confidential, or regulated information unless a formal agreement is in place.

sections.title: 5. Cookies & Analytics
items: Essential cookies for site functionality
Performance analytics
Anonymous usage tracking
sections.extra: Analytics data is used to improve user experience and website performance.

sections.title: 6. Third-Party Providers
sections.content: Crow Systems may use third-party providers for hosting, file storage, form processing, analytics, and email delivery. These providers process data according to their own privacy policies and applicable regulations.

sections.title: 7. Data Security
sections.content: Crow Systems implements reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect submitted information. This includes encryption of data in transit and at rest. However, no online system can guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: 8. Data Retention
sections.content: Information is retained only as long as necessary for business operations, legal obligations, service delivery, and security monitoring. Unused or outdated information may be periodically deleted.

sections.title: 9. User Rights
items: Access to their personal information
Correction of inaccurate data
Deletion requests where applicable
Communication preferences updates
sections.extra: Requests may be submitted to privacy@crowsys.chrislabs.net.

sections.title: 10. International Users
sections.content: Users accessing the website from outside the operating region acknowledge that information may be processed in jurisdictions different from their own, in accordance with applicable data protection regulations.

sections.title: 11. Children's Privacy
sections.content: The website and services are not intended for children under 13 years of age. Crow Systems does not knowingly collect information from children.

sections.title: 12. Changes to Privacy Policy
sections.content: This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically. Updates will be posted on this page with a revised effective date.

sections.title: 13. Contact Information
sections.content: Questions regarding privacy may be directed to privacy@crowsys.chrislabs.net.

The content does not violate laws or third-party rights.
The content does not contain malicious or prohibited material.
sections.extra: Crow Systems reserves the right to reject or remove inappropriate submissions. Audio recordings are handled securely and used solely for consultation review purposes.

Data loss

Temporary website unavailability
sections.extra: All services are provided on an "as available" basis.

systemsConsulting.title: Making Your Tools Talk to Each Other
systemsConsulting.description: Your team stops losing time between tools that don't talk to each other.
systemsConsulting.fullDescription: Your business likely runs on pieces that don't talk to each other: the ordering system, the accounting software, the inventory sheet. That's where hours and money quietly disappear. We connect those pieces, remove the manual copying, and automate the repetitive parts. You end up with fewer errors, clearer reporting, and a team that spends its time serving customers instead of maintaining spreadsheets.
features: Your team stops re-typing the same things twice
Your systems are integrated, so data moves without manual copying
Workflows that keep up as your order volume grows
A clear view of which tools to keep, upgrade, or remove
Reliable reporting from consolidated data
systemsConsulting.idealFor: Businesses where staff re-enter the same data across several tools, teams duplicate each other's work, or reporting depends on stitching spreadsheets together.
systemsConsulting.cta: I want my team to work better

itInfrastructure.title: Keeping Your Business Online
itInfrastructure.description: Your business stays open through storms, surges, and 3am surprises.
itInfrastructure.fullDescription: Your business depends on servers, networks, storage, and security that most people only notice when they stop working. A surge of customers, a forgotten renewal, or an outage in your region can take you offline at the worst moment. We design and maintain the whole setup: monitoring, automated backups, fast recovery, and security that protects your data. If something does break, we detect it early and fix it before your customers ever notice.
features: High availability: your business stays online when it matters
Encrypted data, secure storage, and controlled access
Capacity that grows with your business, without rebuilding
24/7 monitoring with response in under an hour
Proactive maintenance that prevents failures before they happen
itInfrastructure.idealFor: Businesses that can't afford downtime even for an afternoon, handle sensitive data, or are growing and need reliable capacity.
itInfrastructure.cta: I never want to turn a customer away

softwareSolutions.title: Software That Fits You
softwareSolutions.description: Tools that fit your business, not the other way around.
softwareSolutions.fullDescription: Off-the-shelf software rarely fits the way your business actually works. We build custom web applications and internal tools that match your exact processes: customer portals, dashboards, internal systems, and integrations. We rely on proven, modern technology, so the result is dependable, secure, and easy for both your team and your customers to use.
features: Software built around your real processes, not the other way around
Customer portals and interfaces that are simple to use
Manual work automated within the system
Stable systems, tested before every release
Architecture designed to grow with your usage
softwareSolutions.idealFor: Businesses with unique processes that off-the-shelf tools can't cover, or that need to replace fragile legacy software.
softwareSolutions.cta: I want a tool that works for me

technicalStrategy.title: Clear Tech Decisions, No Regrets
technicalStrategy.description: Decide on technology with your eyes open, not a coin flip.
technicalStrategy.fullDescription: Every technology decision has long-term consequences, and most owners make them without all the information. We help you weigh build vs. buy, estimate real costs over time, and avoid tools that box you in. The result is a practical roadmap: what to adopt, what to retire, and where to invest next. Straight recommendations based on engineering experience, not trends or sales pitches.
features: You know where to invest and where spending leads nowhere
Direct recommendations on build, buy, or keep as is
Fewer costly surprises down the road
Decisions that leave room to grow instead of locking you in
Tools selected for your actual situation, not for the sales pitch
technicalStrategy.idealFor: Owners and leaders who make technology decisions without a full in-house technical team.
technicalStrategy.cta: I want to stop guessing on tech

digitalTransformation.title: Modernizing What Matters
digitalTransformation.description: Modernize what matters and make decisions based on real numbers.
digitalTransformation.fullDescription: Modernizing doesn't have to mean replacing everything at once. We modernize the systems that matter most and consolidate your data into a single reliable source, so your reports reflect reality and decisions happen in hours instead of weeks. We work in phases, keep risk low, and keep your operations running throughout.
features: Decisions backed by consolidated, accurate data
Reports that everyone can trust and understand
Data sources connected in one place, no more hunting across tools
The right information reaches the right people on time
Less time gathering data, more time acting on it
digitalTransformation.idealFor: Established businesses with aging systems that want to modernize and consolidate data without disrupting operations.
digitalTransformation.cta: I want decisions from real numbers

automationConsulting.title: Repetitive Work on Autopilot
automationConsulting.description: Put the repetitive work on autopilot, so your team thinks, not copies.
automationConsulting.fullDescription: Many teams lose hours every week to repetitive work: data entry, file processing, reporting, and manual handoffs between tools. We identify the tasks worth automating and build reliable automated workflows with proven tooling. Your team gets freed from busywork and focuses on the customers and decisions that actually move the business.
features: Hours returned to your week
Fewer human errors in critical processes
Deployments and updates that run smoothly, automatically
Data recorded once and synchronized across your systems
Your team focuses on judgment and customer work, not data entry
automationConsulting.idealFor: Teams spending excessive hours on repetitive tasks, or businesses that want to grow without hiring proportionally more staff.
automationConsulting.cta: I want my team's time back
